name: tutorial-trigger-input
title: Trigger Input
description: Demonstrates the unified Trigger Input contract (ADR-0012): triggerInput is the workflow's total input contract and every trigger validates against it, so ${triggerPayload.<field>} reads identically no matter which one fired. Start it by hand (the Start Run form renders these fields), POST {"source":"edc","priority":"urgent"} to its webhook, or attach a cron row carrying that same object as its static payload — all three produce the same triggerPayload. Triggers are independent table resources managed via `mediforce workflow trigger-*` (ADR-0011, Issue #932).

triggerInput.name: source
triggerInput.description: Data source identifier. Supplied by whichever trigger fires: the manual Start Run form, the webhook body's top-level `source` key, or the cron row's static payload.

triggerInput.name: priority
triggerInput.description: Processing priority: normal or urgent. Optional, so a firing may omit it — but an undeclared field is rejected on every path.

steps.name: Record the firing
steps.description: Reads the validated input the same way for every trigger kind. `triggerPayload.*` is the contract; `triggerContext.*` is the transport escape hatch — empty on a manual start, so a step depending on it has knowingly coupled itself to one trigger kind.

steps.name: Route by Priority
steps.description: Route based on triggerInput priority — urgent skips review.
